newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt jails museum thief for three years.
newsitem.headline: Egypt jails museum thief for three years.

text.p: An Egyptian man who tried to steal pharaonic treasures by hiding in a sarcophagus in Cairo's Egyptian Museum until closing time was sentenced to three years imprisonment on Monday by a Cairo criminal court.

Amr Sabry Mohammed, 23, confessed to hiding in the museum on September 10 until it closed for the night, when he emerged from the ancient coffin and broke open several display cases to take more than 20 objects, including gold rings and a dagger of King Tutankhamun.
Tutankhamun was the boy-king whose tomb was found intact in 1922 by British archaeologist Howard Carter.
Mohammed was arrested the next day while trying to leave the museum when a police conscript became suspicious.
The incident shocked Egyptians and highlighted the lax security at the museum, which houses many priceless antiquities.
